name: bollinger_ema_sar_v3_crossover_slope
purpose: Correct the lateral/slope interpretation without changing the core setup. The EMA3/EMA9 cross is allowed to create the initial slope; EMA20 is not required to have been sloping before the signal.
unchanged_from_v1: rocket rejection or body engulfing signal
higher signal low for LONG / lower signal high for SHORT
stop on candle immediately before signal

single_change_v3.removed: EMA20 must already be monotonic for 3 prior transitions
single_change_v3.long_nonlateral: On the closed signal bar EMA3 is rising and EMA9 is rising, while EMA3 crosses above EMA9.
single_change_v3.short_nonlateral: On the closed signal bar EMA3 is falling and EMA9 is falling, while EMA3 crosses below EMA9.
single_change_v3.sideways: NO_TRADE when the fast and signal averages do not slope together in the trade direction at the cross.
single_change_v3.magnitude_threshold: NONE in V3; no optimized slope threshold is introduced.

record: whether EMA9 is already on the trade side of EMA20 at signal close
whether EMA9 crosses EMA20 during the three-bar holding window
ema9_20_diagnostic.reason: Test the user's observation that the 3/9 and 9/20 crossover sequence is where moving averages acquire slope, without delaying the primary entry or changing the V1 exit rule.

comparison: Compare V1, V2 and V3 on sample size, expectancy, PF, drawdown, direction, pattern, session and EMA9/20 diagnostic cohorts. No promotion by win rate alone.
